banner.title: n8n
banner.tagline: Runs the n8n workflow engine on a CloudNativePG database, with the editor on the internal gateway and only webhook paths on the external one.

art.about: a workflow automation engine with a visual editor, a database and public webhook endpoints
art.title: How n8n runs a workflow

steps.title: Key
steps.text: ExternalSecret n8n-secret carries the encryption key, the database login and the superuser login from 1Password items n8n and cloudnative-pg.
steps.scene: a key emerging from a vault

steps.title: Database
steps.text: The cnpg-database component creates role and database n8n on postgres-18. init-postgres waits for them before n8n starts.
steps.scene: a database cylinder with a padlock

steps.title: Editor
steps.text: The editor and REST API sit behind envoy-internal. Liveness checks /healthz, readiness checks /healthz/readiness, which tests the database.
steps.scene: a workflow canvas with three linked nodes

steps.title: Webhook
steps.text: Only /webhook and /rest/oauth2-credential are routed through envoy-external. Every other path stays on the internal gateway.
steps.scene: a globe with a funnel of requests

steps.title: Watch
steps.text: A ServiceMonitor scrapes /metrics on the http port every 30 seconds. Gatus checks readiness, not liveness.
steps.scene: a radar dish over a line chart
